BiblicalUsage: A whirlwind is a storm that catches and carries away, and the book of the wars of the LORD names the whirlwind in the Red Sea. Job says the wicked are as stubble before the wind, and the psalm asks God to make His enemies as the whirlwind drives. Proverbs says destruction will come as a whirlwind when fear arrives.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the whirlwind is God's picture of judgment that cannot be outrun. It takes the stubble and leaves the root, and the wicked are stubble. I hold that the same storm that destroys the wicked also clears the air for the righteous, and God sends it in His time.
